_readme: Source-of-truth facts for outreach content. Every merge field in content/ resolves from here. Anything still tagged [NEEDS REAL DATA] is a placeholder — the compliance gate in src/constrox_sdr/compliance.py blocks any message from being queued for send until its placeholders are replaced with real, approved copy. Do not hand-edit this file with invented claims; only put in facts you can stand behind.
physical_address: [NEEDS REAL DATA - required for CAN-SPAM / UK PECR sender identification]
sender_name: [NEEDS REAL DATA - the human SDR name outreach will be sent from]
unsubscribe_url: [NEEDS REAL DATA - must be a working one-click unsubscribe link]
booking_link: [NEEDS REAL DATA - discovery call scheduling link, e.g. Calendly]
value_prop_long: [NEEDS REAL DATA - 2-3 sentence expanded value proposition]
services: [NEEDS REAL DATA - e.g. quantity takeoff / estimating]
pricing_summary: [NEEDS REAL DATA - only a general pricing model/range if Constrox wants it referenced in outreach; leave blank if pricing is never discussed pre-call]
_notes_for_operator: case_studies and approved_claims are intentionally empty arrays. Populate each case study as {"client_name": ..., "result": ..., "can_be_named_publicly": true/false, "source": "where this was verified"}. Populate approved_claims as short factual strings (e.g. '10+ years serving AEC firms in the UK') that the compliance claim-checker will treat as pre-cleared. Any numeric or superlative claim in generated content that is NOT traceable to one of these two lists gets flagged for legal/compliance review instead of being sent.
